title: Sip & Connect
subtitle: Grow your Network
description: ​Come join us for an afternoon of networking with fellow founders and meet the team behind Founders @ Hunter! Whether you're looking for a co-founder, a mentor, or just a reason to drink the best coffee in NYC, this is where you need to be! Join us for a quick LinkedIn workshop followed by a networking sprint and finish off with some delicious coffees and teas!
itinerary: ​2:30 — Doors open and receive your Networker Card!
​3:00 — Speed Networking: Build your network fast!
